target: Does an mcDSQS(2p) exist for every prime p >= 19 with p congruent to 7 modulo 12? Seek a uniform construction, or a complete counterexample proof.
status_label: DERIVED-RESEARCH-TARGET, not a verbatim named prime-family conjecture. The primary source asks for more mcDSQS examples and constructions. No claim that orders 62 or 86 are open until checked against published constructions.

primary_attestation.quote: Find more examples of mcDSQS(v)s, for example, an mcDSQS(38) and an RDSQS(52)
primary_attestation.parent_read: Local Tan-Zhou text definitions lines 60-134, constructions section 2, open problems lines 1094-1117; sibling audit review/rdsqs52-priority-audit.md.
primary_attestation.baseline: An mcDSQS(38), the p=19 case, is now independently finite-verified and producer-replayed. Primary-source priority audit and additional Lean formalization are still running. Known published families must be compared before any novelty claim.

definitions: One SQS on 2p points; at every point its derived STS(2p-1) has a colouring into p pairwise-disjoint-triple classes, attaining ceil(((2p-1)(2p-2)/6)/floor((2p-1)/3)) = p. The minimum is over all STS(2p-1), not each arbitrary STS.
representation: Test the twisted AGL(1,p) action on F_p x Z_2: (x,i) maps to (a*x+b, i+chi(a)), where chi(a)=0 for a square and 1 for a nonsquare. For primes p congruent to 7 mod 12 the point stabilizer has odd order (p-1)/2. The verified p=19 example has p-1 classes of (2p-2)/3 triples and one class of (p-1)/3 triples. This profile and group invariance are search choices, never hypotheses in a general nonexistence claim.
first_obligation: Bounded primary-art check: does a stated construction already cover every such prime p, or the 62/86 controls? Read the source's constructions, not only its short list. Audit equivalence to known Netto/Schreiber/affine Steiner quadruple constructions and colourings. If already covered, record it and do not relabel it new.
first_cycle: Reproduce p=19 from copied code in the new lane. Probe p=31 then p=43 with a strict 15-minute cap per first probe and no more than four samples per prime. Freeze a parameterized algebraic block/colour formula before claiming a family. Spend the rest of the first <=3-hour cycle on the uniform proof or its concrete obstruction, not on accumulating larger finite examples.
acceptance: A complete uniform proof, with no restriction to group-invariant input designs, backed by exact small controls, independent parent verification, hostile independent-vendor review and matched primary prior-art comparison. Finite certificates are individually promotable only after the usual triple verification/replay gates, and do not prove the family. A model-scoped UNSAT or timeout is not a counterexample to existence.
resource_contract: At most 4 CPU workers and 8 GiB per lane, host-clock checkpoints at most 30 minutes apart, chunks at most 3 hours; overall deadline 2026-10-18T18:31:43-07:00.
permissions: Write only in assigned new lane. Prior lanes and shared run files read-only. No deletion, commit/push, publication, external contact, paid API fallback, global config, cron/launchd or old-engine mutation.
